version.changelog: Clearer disclosure of what is stored and where

llm.summary: The skill is coherent DevOps guidance, but it automatically reads and updates broad local operational notes, including contacts and spending records, without asking first.

dimensions.detail: The declared config scope includes devops, servers, contacts, projects, domains, finances, profile data, and legacy devops paths; this is disclosed and partly purpose-aligned, but broad for routine DevOps advice.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No executable files, install scripts, dependency setup, remote payload retrieval, or tool-wrapping behavior were found in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill directs agents to read persistent DevOps memory at the start of every session, follow a dynamic Boxes index, and write durable results before the session ends.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The memory template explicitly says no permission is needed for writes and allows updates, moves, deletions, and shared-box rows, with mitigation that writes stay local, are announced, and shared boxes only modify rows written by this skill.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The package is a Markdown-only DevOps skill covering CI/CD, deployments, reliability, incidents, secrets handling, supply-chain controls, capacity, and recovery; those topics match the stated purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a DevOps skill that keeps persistent local notes and can read or update shared Clawic records about infrastructure, owners, domains, projects, and delivery-tool spending. Review or constrain persistence if you prefer per-task consent, and avoid recording file paths to private keys when a secrets-manager or environment-variable pointer is available.
llm.findings:
[T05] unexpected: Accepted as a Review concern: artifact text supports automatic persistent read/write access to broad shared Clawic data stores without prior confirmation, although it is local and disclosed.
[PE3] expected: Downgraded from credential-theft concern: the artifact forbids storing secret values and uses credential locators as redacted pointers, but local private-key path pointers are still sensitive metadata users should avoid when possible.
[AE1] expected: Overridden: pipelines.md is present in the artifact and was fully inspected; the references are ordinary internal skill references, not evidence of analysis evasion.
[MP3] expected: Overridden: the cited 'corrupt state' language discusses Terraform/IaC state corruption and rollback, not poisoning agent memory or safety instructions.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Accepted in part: contacts and finances are explained for pager ownership and delivery-tool spend, but default access to those shared records is broader than many tasks need.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part for the shared data-store scope: servers, contacts, projects, domains, and finances are disclosed, but the dynamic Boxes mechanism expands what may be read within ~/Clawic/data/.
[SQP-2] expected: Partly accepted as guidance: GitOps repository edits can affect live environments; the file includes cautions, but users should still treat such changes as production-impacting.
[EA2] expected: Downgraded: incident rollback authority and related language are operational-policy examples, while SKILL.md separately requires explicit confirmation for destructive steps.
[SQP-1] expected: Not material alone: activation guidance is broad but remains within a coherent DevOps domain and includes explicit exclusions.
